request.needsValues: Every field needs a value of up to 64 KiB.
request.allowCredentialTitle: Allow this conversation to use the credential “{name}”?

host_devices.title: Manage Devices
host_devices.description: Manage Devices lets the agents of this conversation list your devices, attach them to this conversation or detach them, and pair a computer they can run commands on with your account. The agents run commands as you on an attached device.

credentials_manage.title: Manage Credentials
credentials_manage.description: Manage Credentials lets the agents of this conversation remove your saved credentials. Your credentials serve every conversation you allow them in.

providers_manage.title: Manage Providers
providers_manage.description: Add, change and remove your provider entries and their models, which every conversation of yours can use.

conversation_organize.title: Organize Conversations
conversation_organize.description: Organize Conversations lets the agents of this conversation rename it, list your projects, make a project of a directory, and move this conversation into or out of one. Projects show in your sidebar on every device.

agent_profiles.title: Change Subagent Profiles
agent_profiles.description: Create, edit and delete the subagent profiles every conversation of yours can use.
